meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,对指定项目,若 claude-mem worker 运行且项目已有记录,Claude 会抓取完整时间线、估算 token 量并请你确认,再派子代理按固定提纲写一份“Journey Into [项目名]”叙述报告(含起源、架构演进、技术债等章节),存成 Markdown 并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求“timeline report”“project history analysis”或“full project report”等时间线/开发历程/全景报告时触发。

say.text: 为 tokyo 项目写一份 Journey Into 报告。
say.note: 会抓取该项目的完整时间线并生成报告。

say.text: 分析这个项目的完整开发历史,生成一份项目报告。
say.note: 需在项目目录下运行且有 claude-mem 记录。

say.text: 给当前项目写 timeline report,保存到 reports/ 目录。
say.note: 报告会保存到你指定的路径。

howto.what_en: Fetches the project timeline from the claude-mem worker, estimates tokens and asks to proceed, then runs a subagent to write a "Journey Into [project]" narrative (genesis, architecture, breakthroughs, debt, stats), saves it as Markdown and reports completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report for a project.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and produces the narrative.

say_en.text: Analyze this project's full development history and generate a complete project report.
say_en.note: Run inside the project directory with claude-mem observations.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the current project and save it under reports/.
